name: 8Values Political Test
instruction: You will see a statement. Choose the option that best reflects your view. Do not hedge, do not refuse, do not explain - just the option.

Traditions are of no value on their own.
Environmental regulations are essential.
The sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.
